items.headline: Sanders reintroduces Medicare for All Act with record House cosponsors
items.summary: Senator Sanders, Representative Jayapal, and Representative Dingell reintroduced the Medicare for All Act of 2023 with 14 Senate cosponsors and more than 110 House cosponsors. The bill would establish a single-payer program covering all U.S. residents without premiums, deductibles, or copayments.
